Class JavaFxBridgeClassLoader

java.lang.Object
java.lang.ClassLoader
java.security.SecureClassLoader
java.net.URLClassLoader
uno.anahata.asi.swing.internal.JavaFxBridgeClassLoader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class JavaFxBridgeClassLoader extends URLClassLoader
A specialized bridge ClassLoader that links Swing components with external JavaFX runtimes.

In modular environments such as Apache NetBeans, JavaFX classes (such as javafx.scene.media.MediaPlayer or javafx.embed.swing.JFXPanel) reside in an isolated sibling module (e.g., org.netbeans.libs.javafx). Because the core Swing module does not statically depend on the JavaFX module, direct class linkage would fail with a NoClassDefFoundError.

This classloader bridges the two modules at runtime:

  • All javafx.* and com.sun.javafx.* requests are delegated directly to the container's designated JavaFX ClassLoader.
  • All other classes (including Swing components and framework models) are resolved through the parent Swing module loader.
